rules.completion: phase completion proposal in PR + independent checks on merged candidate + observed main merge; NO post-merge self-reference in marker
rules.blocking: park branch/draft PR, allow next independent phase only after safety/dependency check
rules.testSemantics: P-tests are design contracts until actually executed; H-series never public CI
rules.operatorLiveTesting: minimal, late and only when necessary; separately authorize exact live side effects

phases.title: Combined XPI and navigable shell
phases.scope: Reproducible combined packaged XPI retaining Gecko ID/native-host compatibility, donor routing/permissions/regressions; six navigable destinations with genuinely disabled actions.
phases.proof: Donor regressions and packaged Firefox installation identity; no PCMS provider effects.
phases.fallback: If donor security or build differs, stop and do not enable PCMS.

completion.claim: Combined PersonaMonkey XPI with six navigable PCMS destinations and genuinely disabled new PCMS actions
executedEvidence: F: signed Stage 7 29-member hash verification, 223-file pinned donor blob/mode/tree verification and negative mutations, ten I00 tests, inherited extension/native regressions
B: exact packaged combined XPI installed persistently in Firefox Developer Edition 154.0b10, surviving full restart with original Gecko ID, six routes, disabled actions, original advanced options
CI: same-run final candidate jobs baseline, fast, firefox, pcms-required all successful, with independently exercised docs-only and failing-dependency aggregate cases
holds: No protected CI-root autonomous auto-merge approval
completion.provenance: Do not embed PR/head/merge commit SHA or future run IDs; correlate through immutable GitHub CI and actual merged main ref

phases.title: Fail-closed background wake and PersonaGuard
phases.scope: Top-level synchronous wake listener registrations; one guarded same-XPI authority path, stable UID/current-container, lease/route checks and runtime health receipts.
phases.proof: Persistent installed XPI cold wake, full restart, route loss, lease revocation and donor security isolation; independent zero-effect oracle.
phases.fallback: Retain protected fail-closed defaults and forbid all PCMS writes.
phases.forbiddenClaim: Live Perchance owner verification or enabled mutation.

phases.title: Journal, canonical commands and emergency diagnostics
phases.scope: Revision-fenced command admission, PREPARED/DISPATCH_POSSIBLE before fake effects, independent restore hold outside replaceable DB, redacted Core-independent diagnostic entrypoint.
phases.proof: DB abort/crash between cutpoints, duplicate requests, untrusted senders, corrupt Core, leak-canary oracle; donor unaffected.
phases.fallback: Canonical DB unavailable => PCMS mutating hold, never donor fail-open.

phases.title: Persona-bound account enrollment
phases.scope: Select/create unbound Persona, human login handoff, verified session identity, one active account per Persona, repair/rebind and honest pending/unknown states.
phases.proof: Fake identity rotations, revoked leases, duplicate account/Persona bindings, UI target revision fencing; no direct native bypass.
phases.forbiddenClaim: Manual UID entry as normal UX or collaborator access as ownership.

phases.title: Owned generator read-only inventory
phases.scope: Guarded read-only inventory sync, positive owner vs editKey separation, unknown/deleted ambiguity, responsive 1,000+ search/filter.
phases.proof: Owner mismatch, account session drift, missing list item, stale out-of-order UI refresh and bounded fleet fixture.
phases.fallback: Unknown owner => target hold; never delete on absence.
phases.forbiddenClaim: Live ownership proven merely by fixture.

phases.title: GitHub READY inspection and source association
phases.scope: Explicit folder↔generator association, full tree/READY/test-input inspection, reject hostile paths and relevant HEAD drift; empty main yields GITHUB_UNINITIALIZED.
phases.proof: Fake Git DAG and path collisions/reincarnation, absent HEAD, READY revocation, irrelevant vs relevant drift.
phases.fallback: Absent Git main or ambiguous tree => SOURCE_PENDING, no writeback.
phases.forbiddenClaim: Private per-gens initialized or READY automatically granted.

phases.title: Private-first slug reservation and batch receipts
phases.scope: Freeze operator slug list, target-specific two-stage private-empty create + guarded rename, bounded per-item receipts, non-READY Git folder only when authorized and possible.
phases.proof: Separate create/rename fake-effect ledgers, lost acknowledgment, collision, uncertain temporary ID, partial batch and Git outage.
phases.fallback: HELD_UNCERTAIN or SOURCE_PENDING, no second create or arbitrary substitute slug.
phases.forbiddenClaim: Earlier historical F1 test proves new combined-XPI live creation.

phases.title: Existing generator adoption without source loss
phases.scope: Explicit adoption consent, durable association, immutable original-source baseline plus non-overwriting Git archive with independently verified integrity.
phases.proof: Slug reincarnation, owner changes, mapped folder collision, archived byte readback, public/unlisted distinctions.
phases.fallback: Ambiguous original or Git archive => preserve provider source, no overwrite.
phases.forbiddenClaim: Adoption equals permission to publish or overwrite.

phases.title: Manual authenticated encrypted backup
phases.scope: One authenticated encrypted archive regardless of content category; consistent snapshot, offline decrypt/schema/source roundtrip of a disposable restore fixture, bounded size, actual Downloads states and excluded WG private config.
phases.proof: Header tamper, wrong passphrase, incomplete export, offline source roundtrip, storage quota, lost Download completion, secret scan.
phases.fallback: Encryption or completion unverified => failure receipt, no plaintext fallback.
phases.forbiddenClaim: Full restore or independent on-disk hash when browser only confirms download.

phases.title: Private candidate staging, full-source verification and editor safety
phases.scope: Pin READY bytes, stage on private new generators, full PJS/HTML/src add/change/delete byte-readback, guarded human tab handoff, source diff and prior snapshot.
phases.proof: Dirty/unknown editor, asset 404 or binary mismatch, save accepted but incomplete readback, crash during tab ownership transfer.
phases.fallback: SOURCE_UNVERIFIED/EDITOR_UNKNOWN => preserve tab and previous source.
phases.forbiddenClaim: Existing public-generator overwrite or clean source on manifest metadata alone.

phases.title: Native AI repair and independently evidenced tests
phases.scope: Settings-versioned Chat 1, optional genuinely fresh Chat 2, observable test oracle on exact saved F, bounded repair convergence; AI may modify all generator-owned source but no privileged Git/approval.
phases.proof: Fresh-session violation, AI prose-only PASS, stale tests after change, source drift, handoff interrupt, prompt revision pin.
phases.forbiddenClaim: Narrative AI success is actual test success.

phases.title: Revision-safe GitHub writeback
phases.scope: Manual/opt-in automatic conditional Git-only multi-file commit of fully verified F (including deletions), nonforced ref with HEAD/readback, suggested message inert.
phases.proof: Fake DAG relevant/unrelated conflicts, blob partial, lost ack, policy changes, auto opt-out race.
phases.fallback: WRITEBACK_UNCERTAIN/CONFLICT; preserve exact F and no publication.
phases.forbiddenClaim: Git commit is Perchance publication or source-bound human approval.

phases.title: Refresher shadow scheduler, monitoring and fleet
phases.scope: One durable oldest-eligible queue, evidenced operational intervals, account grace, scoped Pauses, capacity hysteresis, coalesced alarms, shared recent-list observation/adaptive statistics.
phases.proof: Virtual clock, 50+ account/1,000+ generator fixture, outage distinction, duplicate cold wake, perf high-water marks.
phases.fallback: No mutating refresh until proven permissible effective method; freeze unobserved time.
phases.forbiddenClaim: Queue calculation proves real provider visibility or refresh validity.

phases.title: Exact-source release approval and existing-source updates
phases.scope: Human exact-F publication approval and immediate source/test/owner/READY/editor revalidation; update adopted source only when proven sleeping/unlisted with verified prior-source baseline and decryptable recovery snapshot; safe readback/rollback.
phases.proof: Lost listing ack, changed full F, stale approval modal, changed READY, dirty editor, sleep/unlist race, rollback-to-P remains unlisted.
phases.forbiddenClaim: GitHub writeback authorizes publication, or tested F can change after approval.

phases.title: Permissible evidence-based mutating Refresher
phases.scope: Qualify only legitimate effective mutating refresh candidate; bounded monitored attempt with separate save/effect/recent-feed evidence and gap/absence handling.
phases.proof: Fake effective/ineffective saves, absent/partial feed, provider drift and rate limits; H-04 only if essential late.
phases.fallback: If no permissible verified mechanism, mutation remains disabled and shadow monitoring continues.

phases.title: Scheduled encrypted backup and safe retention
phases.scope: Daily authenticated encryption with safe recoverable secret, optional KDE keyring integration, bounded tracked 14-good automatic archive retention and accurate file proof tiers.
phases.proof: Locked/missing vault, Downloads missing item, moved file, interrupted backup, manual/untracked/last-good preservation.
phases.fallback: Without safe key/vault => suspended, never plaintext or unsafe deletion.
phases.forbiddenClaim: Browser reported completion means independent disk-byte proof.

phases.title: Staged restore and inactive fresh controller
phases.scope: Authenticated preview, verified pre-restore checkpoint, external immutable guard, group-by-group receipts/UID remap, new-profile disabled controller by default.
phases.proof: Crash at every restore boundary, old/new two-profile mock, import collisions, lack of old-controller proof, archive size quotas.
phases.fallback: Unknown group => scoped hold; new controller inactive until actual operator H-06 if migration claimed.
phases.forbiddenClaim: Staged restore is cross-store atomic or old profile automatically off.

phases.title: Full integration, fleet and operator acceptance
authorities: All existing authority boundaries, no new controller
phases.scope: Cross-system fault chains, accessibility, 50+/1,000+ measured envelope, clean build/installation, guided checklist with Markdown fallback and late operator acceptance.
phases.proof: All P56 composites and honest H-01/H-07, H-06 only if migration claimed, H-02–05 conditional residual unknowns.
phases.fallback: Critical failures prevent aggregate product claim; independent capabilities remain scoped OFF/HELD.
phases.forbiddenClaim: H tests performed from CI or capability enabled without necessary real proof.
